quotes: Dubai Careers - Dubai Government job portal
MoHRE grants licences of recruitment agencies to UAE citizens only.
Job seekers are not required to pay money to any recruitment agency as the onus to pay such fees lies with the employers.
If the hiring company or the agency asks you for money to process the visa or medical test, it is not a genuine company.
